title: Recessed Solid Matching Kit
description: One complete static geometric matching set, counted as one prop: one connected thick rectangular board has three real blind cavities with circular, triangular and square profiles, holding a circular cylinder, a triangular prism and a square pyramid. Each separate closed solid has its complete flat base seated on the cavity floor, positive side clearance around its full perimeter and its distinctive upper shape exposed. The board has continuous outer walls, actual inward cavity walls and 24 mm of material below the cavity floors. Cavities are actual geometry, never dark overlays. Four editable closed meshes, four opaque constant PBR materials, metres, source Z up, front -Y and ground-centre origin. No textures, words, characters, table or surrounding scene.
